# NextPluggable

> WordPress-style plugins for Next.js. One package gives a site a dashboard where its owner installs, configures, updates and removes plugins from GitHub repositories, with no rebuild and no redeploy.

Each guide below is a complete, self-contained instruction set written for coding agents. The guides change as NextPluggable does: each states a revision number and lists what changed, and a project that follows one should record that number in its CLAUDE.md and check it at the start of each task.

## Guides

- [Integrate](https://rohittp0.github.io/NextPluggable/integrate.md) (revision 3): Add the dashboard, API route, plugin pages and layout slots to an existing Next.js site.
- [Build plugins](https://rohittp0.github.io/NextPluggable/build.md) (revision 3): Set up a plugin repository, write the manifest, components and server code, and ship updates.

## Optional

- [Research and decisions](https://rohittp0.github.io/NextPluggable/research.md): why plugins are loaded at runtime, and the limits that follow
- [Source code](https://github.com/rohittp0/NextPluggable)
